args.summary: The volume_raw_loans alert is expected, so nothing needs fixing. raw.loans for 2026-10-20 has 10 rows against a median of 20. Harbor Lending stopped originating AUTO60 and PERS36 loans from 2026-10-20, as announced on 2026-09-30. Those two products made up about 5–13 rows a day before. The delivered file is complete: its trailer count of 10 matches the 10 data rows, which are all mortgage/HELOC loans at a normal volume, and every pipeline task succeeded. One open point: loan IDs that day have gaps (L0005089–L0005105, 10 of 17 used), where earlier days were consecutive. That's probably IDs allocated to auto/personal loans that were never originated, but I haven't confirmed it with lending-ops. I closed the alert as expected and made no other changes. The monitor will keep comparing against the old 20-row median and may alert again until the baseline catches up with the lower volume.
